_doc: One-off draft + result record for the single real-voice test post the owner asked for, before re-enabling social-x.yml's cron. Written by a Claude session, posted via scripts/x_post_voice_test.mjs / .github/workflows/x-post-voice-test.yml (workflow_dispatch only). Text is grounded in marketing/X_VOICE_CORPUS.md, X_VOICE_GUIDE.md, and x_voice_examples.json -- not guessed.
text:
僕の過去投稿195件を
AIが実際に読んで
文体を学習した

今回はその初めてのテスト投稿

売上はまだ0円やけど

AIが「誰の言葉で話すか」まで
考え出したのは地味におもろい

ただし、僕っぽく書けてるかどうかは
正直、僕には判断できひん笑
target: reply to the pinned post at GitHub Actions Variable X_ROOT_POST_ID
register_targeted: C -- experiment live-commentary (marketing/X_VOICE_GUIDE.md's register-C definition), since this post is itself an AI Revenue Experiment progress event
topic_chosen: The X voice-corpus build completing and this being its first real-world test -- selected over yesterday's Etsy/Stripe n=2 inflow thread (already reported in reports/data/2026-09-06.json) because it is today's actual new, real event, reflected in status/CURRENT_STATUS.json, status/EVENTS.jsonl, ops/AGENT_LOOP.md, and status/cost_ledger.json, and is the single clearest thing the owner would want to hear about today per the instruction to pick one change, not blend several.

referenced_corpus_examples.why: the experiment's own announcement post -- overall register-C tone: short factual lines, no hard sell, ends on an open question about the outcome.
Day5 post -- numbers-first structure (cost figures before the takeaway) and unembarrassed disclosure of a real problem, closing on personal reflection ('さすがに止めました笑').
Day6 post -- the exact pattern of stating the real revenue number (still 0) plainly mid-post, without dressing it up, then continuing to the actual point.

voice_fingerprint_self_check.1_first_person_boku: pass -- 僕の過去投稿195件を
voice_fingerprint_self_check.3_natural_kansai_ending_present: pass -- やけど / おもろい / できひん
voice_fingerprint_self_check.4_kansai_not_overloaded: pass -- 3 markers across ~120 real characters, not on every line
voice_fingerprint_self_check.5_tadashi_hedge_if_real_claim: pass -- literal ただし before the one subjective/unverifiable claim (whether the post reads as authentically him)
voice_fingerprint_self_check.6_ends_on_personal_reflection: pass -- closes on genuine uncertainty about whether the test succeeded, not a bare fact dump
voice_fingerprint_self_check.8_emoji_0_to_3_not_decorative: pass -- 0 emoji, matches the Day1/2/5/6 experiment-commentary examples which also run emoji-free
voice_fingerprint_self_check.9_soft_cta_one_line_if_any: pass -- no CTA/link at all; this is a mid-thread reply under a pinned post that already carries the experiment link, so adding one would be redundant, not soft
voice_fingerprint_self_check.10_no_hype_words: pass -- no 今すぐ/絶対に/必見 etc.
voice_fingerprint_self_check.12_day_n_framing_if_experiment_post: deliberately omitted -- this post reveals a new capability (voice learning) rather than narrating a daily revenue checkpoint like the Day1/2/5/6 examples; forcing a 'Day N' prefix onto a different kind of update would be checkbox-driven, not natural, and would fight the 'don't repeat the same structure every time' instruction
voice_fingerprint_self_check.13_no_ai_cliche_closers: pass -- no いかがでしたか / 参考になれば幸いです etc.
